name: Couro e Papel
author: BestCode
description: Reskin of the game menus (crafting, inventory, hotbar, research table, buttons) in leather and paper, matching the BestCode panels. With the inventory open, the same leather journal as the logbook (T) lies open behind the menus: categories and recipe list on the left page at full size (long rows break onto a second line instead of crossing the spine), the selected recipe on the foot of the left page under the list, the inventory alone on the right page, the world dimmed around it. Everything is painted in memory and restored when the mod is unloaded.
